title: Todoist Business to self-hosted Vikunja
summary: Todoist Business is cheap per seat, which makes this a genuine test of whether a $96-a-year subscription is worth escaping at all.

you_lose: Todoist's natural-language quick add, which is the feature most people actually stay for
Mature apps on every platform, including watch and widget support
Karma, streaks and the habit machinery that makes people keep using it
you_gain: A Go binary that runs comfortably on the smallest box any provider sells
Free seats, so the whole team costs the same as one person
Kanban, Gantt and list views without a higher tier

caveats: Vikunja imports from Todoist directly, which is why the migration estimate is low. Recurring tasks are the part that most often needs rebuilding by hand.
Todoist Business is one of the cheaper subscriptions on this site. At small team sizes the arithmetic here usually favours simply paying it.
